input.summary:
Loft furnished in parts/room-14.mjs: a slab-topped focal work table on the centre line under a hung lantern, benches, one-board pallets, barrels and chests on the end walls, and tie beams at y23 with chain-hung lanterns plus three standing lanterns.
Walk OK (1097/1097 reachable), light min 4 with 0 dark cells, make.sh whole with 247 placed and no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines; no orphans or floating blocks inside the loft box.
Clear lanes kept at the loading-door cells (x10..13 and x29..32, z4..7 and z30..33) and at the stair 2 foot (x3..6, z22..31).
left: plan.md's P1..P6 checklist and elements.md were not ticked: room-14 is not a P-item, and the loft's structural items belong to the frame and shell parts.
The focal table is weak in the inside render: its slab top at y20 and hung lantern read small against the barrels. A bigger focal piece, or a hoist-side workstation, would sharpen the room.
The stair 2 cells at x5 z23..28 show as 'o' in the plan (already there, not mine); I left them alone and did not confirm what they are.
Beams at y23 (z 8, 16, 25, 30) and chains at y22 are written by this part inside the loft box. The frame part should know they exist if it reads the head line.

waste.what: Floor furniture was drawn with put() on absolute x/z coordinates, then turned into text rows, instead of drawing the grid straight from `mcd plan` output.
waste.cost: about 30 rectangle calls, computed by hand, one retry after a layout bug (stacked pallets made unreachable top cells).
waste.tool: `mcd plan` could print an editable text grid with a legend and an x/z ruler the design can be typed into directly.

waste.what: Lantern placement by trial: three rebuilds to clear the last dark cells. The room check named only the lamp spots, not the dark cell's coordinates.
waste.cost: 4 make.sh + room runs, each about 20 s.
waste.tool: `mcd room` could print the coordinates of each dark floor cell, and a `--fix` mode that proposes a standing or hanging lantern for each.

waste.what: Chains and hanging lanterns placed one at a time with a loop over a hand-picked list of x/z pairs. Tie beams at y23 were laid with beam() but their positions were worked out by eye.
waste.cost: about 12 lantern positions, two beams, one extra beam for the south dark corner.
waste.tool: a vocab helper `hangLantern(g, x, z, y)` (iron chain plus hanging lantern under a beam) and a `ceilingBeams(g, box, spacing, axis)` for overhead beams would have made this one call.

waste.what: Read the inside render by eye for focal reading, since no tool checks whether the focal piece is the most visible object.
waste.cost: one Read of room.png; judged by eye.
waste.tool: `mcd rooms` could report the focal object's visible share of the view.

companions.task: Hand over the dark-corner check and let them place every standing and hanging lantern from the room's light map in one pass, so I would not have had to rebuild three times.
Confirm what the 'o' cells at x5 z23..28 are in the stair 2 run, and whether the lantern at (4,19,32) and the foot clearance at x3..6 z22..31 still line up with their stringer.
